name: Due Diligence
description: Before we discuss terms, I need to know you can find what others can't. An encrypted military drive and a secure flash drive, recovered in the field. Copies won't do.
success: Genuine, both of them. You'll find I'm generous with people who don't waste my time.

name: Discretion
description: My clients value discretion. Go through the factory offices, remove two PMCs who were asking questions about me, and leave without being seen leaving. Quietly, if you can manage it.
success: Two fewer questions. Discretion is a habit. Keep it.

name: Samples
description: A buyer of mine wants to see the quality of what comes out of this valley. Two bands of dollars and a vintage camera, recovered in the field. Samples, you understand. Not a sale.
success: Excellent samples. The buyer is pleased, which means I am pleased.

name: Fine Print
description: A client of mine collects military electronics and pays well above market. A thermal imaging module and an encrypted satellite phone, untouched, found out there. Read the fine print: found, not bought.
success: Untouched, as promised. The fine print is satisfied, and so is my client.

name: The Marked Room
description: There is a room in the customs dorms with a mark on its door. A client left something in it and wants to know it's still there. Look, don't take, and leave by the crossroads.
success: Still there. My client sleeps better, and pays better when he sleeps.

name: Admin Office
description: The resort's administrator kept an intelligence folder in his office safe, I'm told. Retrieve it and carry it out yourself. The folder stays with you. The information is for me.
success: Thank you. Keep the folder. What was in it is already in my head.

name: Board Meeting
description: The board of Lab Zero never adjourned its last meeting. Attend it: the manager's office, then the server hall, and leave by the parking gate as a board member would.
success: Minutes taken. A fascinating meeting, I'm sure, for those who survived it.

name: Portfolio
description: I am rebalancing a client's portfolio away from paper. Two physical bitcoins, recovered in the field. In return, something heavy from my own crates.
success: The portfolio thanks you. So does the client, in dollars.

name: Final Offer
description: My final offer to a very old client: an encrypted field transmitter and a diamond necklace, both found out there. In exchange, the best kit I have ever had in this suite. Everything has a price.
success: A pleasure doing business. I mean that, which is rare.
